title: メディア文化論
subtitle: Culture, Society and Technology in Media Contents
keywords: Culture, Society and Technology in Media
educationalGoal: The innovation of media technologies has transformed modes of expression and has also brought changes to society and culture. In this course, we will examine valuable media-related materials held by our university such as letterpress-printed books, LP records and their jackets, posters, UI collections, and contemporary digital media. Through these materials, students will understand of the relationship between media and expression, as well as the impact of media on culture.
advice: The innovation of media technologies has transformed modes of expression and has also brought changes to society and culture. In this course, we will examine valuable media-related materials held by our university such as first editions of letterpress-printed books, LP records and their jackets, posters, UI and CI collections as well as examples of contemporary digital media. Through these materials, students will gain a multifaceted understanding of the relationship between media and expression, as well as the impact of media on culture. In addition, by analyzing the relationship between technology and expression from the past to the present, the course aims to foster an understanding of the interrelationship between media technology and media design.
requiredKnowledge: We focus on familiar, everyday media and examine the relationship between their technical characteristics and the expressive qualities of their content.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The innovation of media technologies has transformed modes of expression and has also brought changes to society and culture. In this course, we will examine valuable media-related materials held by our university such as first editions of letterpress-printed books, LP records and their jackets, posters, UI and CI collections as well as examples of contemporary digital media. Through these materials, students will gain a multifaceted understanding of the relationship between media and expression, as well as the impact of media on culture. In addition, by analyzing the relationship between technology and expression from the past to the present, the course aims to foster an understanding of the interrelationship between media technology and media design.
